content.comment_body: Good evening, despite the information I found on the forum, I'm unable to change the character height for analog value displays. It seems that the program does not recognize or update the modifications. If anyone can assist me, thank you in advance.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is struggling to adjust the font size for analog value displays, as changes are not being recognized or reflected by the system. This indicates possible usability issues or limitations in how display property modifications are processed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an intuitive way to modify and see immediate updates to the display size of analog values within the product.
